svg.text: Sales Director at Cascade Health LLC

text.tspan: For anyone juggling more than they admit.
Youth sports sideline energy is a lot, and
also kind of beautiful.
My voice was gone by the fourth quarter and I
am not sorry.
Respect officials even when the call stings.
— Liam
One step at a time.
Being a good teammate outlasts any single
season.
My voice was gone by the fourth quarter and I
am not sorry.
Youth sports should still feel like play
sometimes.
We rotated playing time more fairly and
chemistry improved.
Sideline behavior is part of the coaching
curriculum.
We lost, and the kids still wanted ice cream.
Correct priorities.
Sportsmanship is a public practice.
Film review was five minutes of specifics, not
a rant.
Being a good teammate outlasts any single
season.
I thanked the refs even when I disagreed. Kids
were watching.
Teams remember who stayed steady after
mistakes.
I packed water and snacks like a logistics
coordinator.
Being a good teammate outlasts any single
season.
Film review was five minutes of specifics, not
a rant.
Effort is a skill you can reinforce.
We celebrated hustle plays louder than
highlight plays.
Teams remember who stayed steady after
mistakes.
Practice ended with a habit drill that looked
boring and mattered.
Being a good teammate outlasts any single
season.
